services.name: Muay thai
services.desc: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is based around the concept that a smaller, weaker fighter can defeat a larger opponent with the use of superior technique and strategies like joint manipulation. And at Combat Sports Boston, you can master this centuries-old discipline while also taking on a total body workout that will help you get in great shape. Our BJJ classes focus on ground grappling and proper self-defense strategies and can prepare you for either competition or a real-world conflict. During each of our classes, you'll be challenged with ground fighting and standing strategies and you'll be pushed like never before to use practical strength to your advantage. You don't want to miss out on this.
